core_types.name: Registry
core_types.description: Thread-safe metric collector registration and gatherer coordinator

core_types.name: Counter
core_types.description: Monotonically increasing floating point counter metric

core_types.name: MetricVec
core_types.description: Partitioned metric bundle indexed by label value arrays

concurrency_model.type: Lock-Free / Atomic Ingestion with Read-Locked Gathering
concurrency_model.synchronization: sync/atomic for metric values; sync.RWMutex for MetricVec label index maps

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: Scrape HTTP request context aborts exposition stream if client disconnects
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: Zero lingering goroutines for counter/gauge observations

retry_model.strategy: No internal retry; metrics ingestion is fire-and-forget

boundaries.os: Process / Linux procfs memory, CPU, and FD descriptors via procfs collectors
boundaries.serialization: Prometheus text format (0.0.4) and OpenMetrics text exposition
